name: Disneyland Red Rose Taverne Tavern Double Angus Cheeseburger & Fries
whyItWorks: Two 1/3 lb Angus beef patties with melted cheddar cheese on a soft brioche bun. When ordered plain without Thousand Island sauce, pickles, or raw onions, it is very easy on digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Tavern Double plain with ketchup only (hold tavern sauce, raw onions, and pickles).
watchOuts: Hold raw onions, pickles, and tavern sauce
